mascot: Clock Chintu — a friendly round wall clock with big kind eyes, moving hands and a sunny smile

slides.title: Day and Night 🌞🌙
slides.text: A full day and night has SUN time and MOON time. In the day the sun is up and we play and go to school. At night it is dark, stars twinkle, and we sleep!
slides.spoken: Daytime has the sun; nighttime has the moon and stars.

slides.title: My Day in Order 🕐
slides.text: Every day happens in ORDER! Morning: wake up and breakfast. Then school and lunch. Evening: play. Night: dinner and sleep. The order never changes!
slides.spoken: Wake up, school, play, sleep — our day goes in order.

slides.title: Earlier and Later ⏰
slides.text: Things that happen first happen EARLIER. Breakfast is earlier than dinner. Sleep is LATER than school. Earlier means sooner in the day!
slides.spoken: Earlier happens first in the day; later happens after.

slides.title: The Clock and O'Clock 🕒
slides.text: A clock has hands! The LONG hand points to 12 and the SHORT hand tells the hour. When the short hand points to 3 and the long hand to 12, it is 3 o'clock!
slides.spoken: Short hand says the hour when the long hand points to 12.

slides.title: Long and Short Time ⏳
slides.text: Some things take a LONG time, like sleeping all night. Some take a SHORT time, like clapping once or brushing teeth. We can compare how long things take!
slides.spoken: Sleeping takes a long time; clapping takes a short time.

challenges.question: When do we usually see the sun?
challenges.hint: The sun lights up the daytime sky!
challenges.misconception: The sun shines in the day; at night we see the moon and stars.

challenges.question: Which happens EARLIER in the day?
challenges.hint: Which meal comes first after waking up?
challenges.misconception: Breakfast is the morning meal, so it happens earlier than dinner.

challenges.question: What do we usually do at NIGHT?
challenges.hint: It is dark at night and our bodies need rest.
challenges.misconception: Night is for sleeping and resting.

challenges.question: Which takes a LONGER time?
challenges.hint: Think: which one goes on and on for hours?
challenges.misconception: A whole night of sleep takes many hours — much longer than a clap!

challenges.question: Which thing comes FIRST in your day?
challenges.hint: What do you do the moment the morning starts?
challenges.misconception: We wake up first, then lunch comes, and bed comes at night.

challenges.question: Sort each thing: does it belong to DAY or NIGHT?
challenges.hint: If the sun is up, it is day!
challenges.misconception: Sun and singing birds belong to day. Stars and the moon belong to night.

challenges.question: The short hand points to 4 and the long hand points to 12. What time is it?
challenges.hint: The short hand tells the hour. It points to 4!
challenges.misconception: Short hand on 4 with long hand on 12 means 4 o'clock.

challenges.question: Which takes a SHORT time?
challenges.hint: Which one is finished in a few minutes?
challenges.misconception: An apple is eaten in minutes — a short time.
